title: Curated event
description: One row of data/curated/events.jsonl: a tournament admitted by the committed event-selection rule in tools/dataset/rules/event-selection.json (spec R1). Contains no build timestamp, because the file must be byte-identical across builds (spec R8).

id.description: Opaque surrogate key derived from overviewPage (spec D3). Do not parse it: read the row through `name` or `overviewPage`.

name.description: The source's own display name, so the row reads without decoding the ID (spec R12).

overviewPage.description: The source page this event was recorded from, and the input to its canonical ID.

league.description: The source's League string, verbatim. Empty when the source records none, which is possible for an event admitted by a per-event override (see the rule file).

region.description: The source's Region string, verbatim. Not constrained to International here: a per-event override may admit an event on a stated reason (see the rule file).

dateStart.description: Source DateStart as a UTC calendar date. Absent if the source has none, which fails the build rather than emitting an undateable event.

year.description: UTC calendar year of dateStart, repeated so a reader can group without parsing the date.

selection.description: Which clause of tools/dataset/rules/event-selection.json admitted this event. The reason text lives once, in that file, under this key.
